provenance.notes: The repository was independently initialized and fetched only at the frozen pre-fix SHA. The supplied patch applied cleanly and its resulting blob prefixes match the patch headers. The solver commit object was not fetched; revision identity is verified by agreement among result.json, solution.md, and submission.md, plus immutable patch and reconstructed tree evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.details: Default calls for st, nd, rd, and th each return zero. Representative ordinary cardinals and ordinals retain their expected output.

tests.details: Focused regression: 1 passed, 3 deselected, covering all four suffixes. Full practical suite: 69 passed, 0 failed, with 386 pre-existing ast deprecation warnings.

regressions.details: Independent probes covered zero, ordinary cardinals, single-digit ordinals, teen ordinals, compound ordinals, 100th, wantlist, grouping, and a custom zero word. A threshold-option probe still raises ValueError before suffix normalization; this ordering predates and is outside the stated default-call acceptance.

explainability.details: The patch matches the diagnosed empty-payload path: after a recognized suffix is removed, an empty payload is normalized to 0 and ordinal post-processing is disabled so the result is zero rather than zeroth.

prReadiness.details: The change is five localized implementation lines plus a focused four-input regression. Functional suite, build, compilation, and whitespace evidence pass; optional historical plugin limitations are disclosed.

build.details: uv build successfully produced both an sdist and wheel. compileall passed for inflect.py and tests/test_numwords.py.

lint.details: The historical repository runs lint through optional pytest-flake8/pytest-black plugins. They were not present in the reproducible functional environment, and an attempted optional testing-extra installation did not complete. git diff --check passed.
lint.notApplicableReason: Historical optional lint plugin stack unavailable; no standalone frozen lint command or lockfile is supplied at this revision.

typecheck.details: The historical repository delegates typing to optional pytest-mypy. That plugin was not present and could not be installed during QA. Functional tests and bytecode compilation passed.
typecheck.notApplicableReason: Historical optional type-check plugin stack unavailable; no standalone frozen type-check environment is supplied at this revision.

limitations: Python 3.12.14 on Linux only; no full interpreter matrix.
The suite emits 386 unrelated deprecation warnings for legacy ast APIs.
With threshold set, suffix-only strings still reach float conversion before suffix handling and raise ValueError; the issue acceptance describes default calls only.
The solver commit object was not fetched because independent QA was restricted to the exact pre-fix source and supplied artifacts.
